name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Liquid Floating Capsule Dock: Elevated bottom navigation with glossy glass finish and active theme glow.
100% Vector Icons: Completely replaced all emojis across the entire APK with crisp theme-adaptive SVG icons.
Search Studio Redesign: Fixed Photos & Wallpapers horizontal scrolling and redesigned Multi-Filter pill.
Theme Card Differentiation: Frosted glassmorphism with abstract moving gradient in Glass/Prism themes, pure solid deep black in AMOLED.
Atmospheric Footer Gradient: Moving ambient gradient aura radiating from bottom to the floating dock.
